sectors.label: RWA & Stablecoins

sectors.label: Perp DEX & DeFi

sectors.label: L1 Majors
sectors.rationale: ETH roughly flat to lower in early October (about $2,725 on Oct 5, slightly below Oct 1); majors lack a distinct catalyst in what could be found.

sectors.label: AI & Agents
sectors.rationale: AI remains the dominant equity theme (AI-linked >80% of S&P gains per Jefferies); crypto-side AI narratives (agentic economy, AI x DePIN) appear mostly in promotional posts, so crypto attention is uncertain.

sectors.label: Memecoins
sectors.rationale: CoinGecko frames memes as a cultural staple but the market is favoring yield/privacy/utility protocols; no fresh euphoric run found. Low-confidence.
